rationale: C103 flagged negative fair values of -89000 and -187000. Raw source shows these are filer-presented negative fair value marks, not extraction sign errors: Femur Buyer Inc appears in the unfunded commitment schedule as a 1st Lien Senior Secured Revolving Loan with fair value (89), and Spanx has a source SOI row with fair value (187) plus a separate revolving-loan unfunded commitment schedule row. Because the values are source-presented and the issue is the rule not recognizing the commitment/revolver presentation, the flag is a false alarm.
